name: I would like to upload some

messages.content: I would like to upload some files and PDFs to work with, what's the path to my files or how can I upload

You have a few easy ways to upload and work with files or PDFs: ### 1. Upload Directly via Chat (Best for analysis or review) * **How:** Click the **paperclip / attachment icon** in the chat input or drag and drop files directly into this chat box. * **Best when:** You want me to read, summarize, extract text from, or incorporate content from your documents into the site. --- ### 2. Drag & Drop into the File Explorer (Best for website downloads/viewing) * **How:** In the file tree / explorer on the left sidebar, drag and drop files directly into the project folder. * **Workspace Path:** The root path is: `/home/agent/workspace/` * **Best when:** You want PDFs or documents hosted on your website so visitors can view or download them. > [!TIP] > If you upload PDFs for site visitors, we can organize them into a `files/` or `documents/` folder (alongside [images](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/images/)), and link them directly in [index.html](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/index.html) or [forms.html](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/forms.html) like: > ```html > Download Brochure (PDF) > ``` --- ### 3. Via GitHub * You can also upload or commit files directly to your GitHub repository (**`taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website`**). --- Once you upload or attach them, let me know what you'd like to do with them (e.g., add download buttons on the site, display their contents, etc.)!
